lines.zh: 我嘴里含着毒，别让我喷。
lines.en: My mouth is full of venom — do not make me spit.

lines.zh: 我走向巢的方向，不会有人等。
lines.en: I walk toward the hive; no one will be waiting.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，数到忘了数。
lines.en: I count my steps until I forget the count.

lines.zh: 我吐的东西，是绿色的。
lines.en: What I spit comes out green.

lines.zh: 土里的腐味，像我出生的地方。
lines.en: The rot in the soil smells like where I was born.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，那时还没菌。
lines.en: I walked this road before the sculk came.

lines.zh: 我走的每一步，草都变灰。
lines.en: Every step I take, the grass greys.

lines.zh: 我闻到前面活人的汗味。
lines.en: I smell a living creature's sweat ahead.

lines.zh: 骨头响，是幽匿在长。
lines.en: Bones clicking means sculk is growing.

lines.zh: 腿是新长出来的，不听使唤。
lines.en: New legs, and they won't obey.

lines.zh: 我一步又一步，菌毯在长。
lines.en: Step by step, the sculk mat grows.

lines.zh: 白天，我讨厌这刺眼的光。
lines.en: Daytime—I hate this glaring light.

lines.zh: 我的口水是绿的。
lines.en: My spit is green.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里总有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something is always crawling in my throat.

lines.zh: 我听见虫在哭吗？没有。
lines.en: Do I hear insects weeping? No.

lines.zh: 我该吐下一口了，再等等。
lines.en: Time to spit again—wait a little.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己原来的名字。
lines.en: I have forgotten my original name.

lines.zh: 呼吸？我这具身体早忘了。
lines.en: Breathe? This body forgot how long ago.

lines.zh: 我数一数剩下的肋骨。
lines.en: Let me count the ribs I have left.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见菌丝长。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear mycelium grow.

lines.zh: 生前我喜欢蹲在这块石头上。
lines.en: In life I liked crouching on this stone.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我照样吐。
lines.en: Dawn or not, I keep spitting.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿喷毒幼体，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Brood Spitter. Remember.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着的东西，别问。
lines.en: Don't ask what's in my mouth.

lines.zh: 幽匿里有你的味道，很久了。
lines.en: Your scent has been in the sculk a long time.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑也跑不出毒雾。
lines.en: Don't run; you can't outrun the venom mist.

lines.zh: 我一喷就是一片绿。
lines.en: One spit and everything goes green.

lines.zh: 你认识这身菌壳下的我吗？
lines.en: Do you know me beneath this sculk shell?

lines.zh: 我还小，毒已经够用。
lines.en: Small as I am, my venom works.

lines.zh: 我多久没见过这么红的脸。
lines.en: How long since I saw such a red face.

lines.zh: 活人，还是热乎的，我闻到了。
lines.en: A living one, still warm—I smell it.

lines.zh: 别关灯，我怕黑也怕光。
lines.en: Don't turn off the light—I fear dark and glare alike.

lines.zh: 再来，我这身菌壳扛得住。
lines.en: Again—this sculk shell can take it.

lines.zh: 你站的那块菌毯，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the sculk mat you stood on.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，我的毒也不小。
lines.en: You hit hard; my venom hits harder.

lines.zh: 活着时，我还没孵过卵。
lines.en: In life, I had never incubated eggs.

lines.zh: 退后，别惊了我的卵。
lines.en: Back off—don't startle my eggs.

lines.zh: 我吐的是一口脓。
lines.en: What I spit is pus.

lines.zh: 疼，这身烂肉居然还会疼。
lines.en: Pain—this rotten flesh can still feel it.

lines.zh: 别碰伤口，卵会沾上菌。
lines.en: Don't touch the wound; the eggs will catch the sculk.

lines.zh: 别打了，毒囊快破了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my venom sac is about to burst.

lines.zh: 我才十五点血，别追了。
lines.en: I've only fifteen points of health — stop chasing me.

lines.zh: 腐肉，我生前就爱吃。
lines.en: Rotten flesh—I loved it in life.

lines.zh: 幽匿的幼体，吐的是孢子。
lines.en: Sculk brood spits spores.

lines.zh: 血味钻进我的孵囊里。
lines.en: The smell of blood seeps into my brood sac.

lines.zh: 活物的气味太浓，我忍不住。
lines.en: Living scent is so strong; I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 就一口，我保证只吐一点。
lines.en: Just one bite—I promise only a little spit.

lines.zh: 腐味，和我胃里的一样。
lines.en: This rot smells like the inside of my stomach.

lines.zh: 饿这个字，我记了很久。
lines.en: I've remembered the word hunger a long time.

lines.zh: 放下，我只要一小口。
lines.en: Set it down; I only want a small bite.

lines.zh: 饥饿没有底，我的毒囊也没有。
lines.en: Hunger has no bottom, and neither does my venom sac.

lines.zh: 你的手离我远点，会烂。
lines.en: Keep your hand away or it will rot.

lines.zh: 咔哒，谁踩到我的指节？
lines.en: Click—who stepped on my knuckle?

lines.zh: 这算挑衅，还是给我送上门？
lines.en: Is this a challenge, or a delivery to my door?

lines.zh: 站稳，别踩到我。
lines.en: Steady, do not step on me.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我肩上掉菌渣。
lines.en: One bump and sculk crumbs fall off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 别推，我的毒囊会晃破。
lines.en: Don't shove me; my venom sac might burst.

lines.zh: 幼体的毒，才四点。
lines.en: Four points of venom, from a broodling.

lines.zh: 我只剩十五点，别硬碰。
lines.en: I'm down to fifteen; don't push.

lines.zh: 我身上有土，别靠太近。
lines.en: I am covered in soil — do not come too close.

lines.zh: 我让开，慢慢挪到墙边。
lines.en: I move aside and slide slowly to the wall.

lines.zh: 你身上太烫，我的毒会熟。
lines.en: You're so hot my venom would cook.

lines.zh: 这副身子，孵不出什么。
lines.en: This body can't hatch anything.

lines.zh: 我这小身子，只会吐幽匿。
lines.en: This small body only spits sculk.

lines.zh: 想抱你，又怕把你染了。
lines.en: I want to hold you, but fear I'd stain you.

lines.zh: 永恒这东西，我身上就有。
lines.en: Eternity? I carry it in this body.

lines.zh: 我们只配站在菌毯的阴影里。
lines.en: We are fit only for the shadow of the sculk mat.

lines.zh: 靠近点，不，别碰我的卵。
lines.en: Closer—no, don't touch my eggs.

lines.zh: 别看我，我还没长全。
lines.en: Don't look — I'm not finished.

lines.zh: 卵壳里出来的我，不该想这些。
lines.en: Hatched from a brood shell, I should not think such thoughts.

lines.zh: 幼体的手指，还没长牢。
lines.en: A broodling's fingers aren't set yet.

lines.zh: 我这副小身子，撑不了多久。
lines.en: This small body will not last long.

lines.zh: 我吐的东西，会在土里长。
lines.en: What I spit grows in the soil.

lines.zh: 喷出来的毒，也是幽匿的。
lines.en: What I spit is sculk too.

lines.zh: 拿稳，别让我的毒液洒了。
lines.en: Hold it steady; don't spill my venom.

lines.zh: 我的指关节僵了，抓不牢。
lines.en: My knuckles are stiff and can't grip.

lines.zh: 这块，是给我的？
lines.en: Is this one for me?

lines.zh: 十五点血，喷一口就赚了。
lines.en: Fifteen health, and one spit is profit.

lines.zh: 我手里总算抓到点东西。
lines.en: At last my hand closes on something.

lines.zh: 我吐一口孢子，能长一片。
lines.en: One spit of spores grows a patch.

lines.zh: 这味道，像活人刚用过。
lines.en: This smells like something a living person just used.

lines.zh: 喷毒的幼体，护住嘴里的。
lines.en: The spitting larva guards what is in its mouth.

lines.zh: 幽匿的幼体，等你跑够了。
lines.en: A sculk spawn waits till you're done running.

lines.zh: 我闻出你身上有新鲜血肉。
lines.en: I smell fresh flesh and blood on you.

lines.zh: 谁先动，我就先吐谁。
lines.en: Whoever moves first gets my spit first.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，喷出一口幽匿毒。
lines.en: I open my mouth and spit sculk venom.

lines.zh: 我盯上了，视线收不回来。
lines.en: I'm fixed on you; my gaze won't come back.

lines.zh: 站着别动，让我瞄喉咙。
lines.en: Stand still and let me aim at your throat.

lines.zh: 追上你，只差一口唾沫。
lines.en: Catching you takes only one spit.

lines.zh: 你心跳太吵，我听得头疼。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is so loud it aches my head.

lines.zh: 站住，活人。
lines.en: Halt, living one.

lines.zh: 你那双眼睛，归我的毒了。
lines.en: Those eyes of yours belong to my venom now.

lines.zh: 让你久等，我的毒刚酿好。
lines.en: Sorry to keep you; my venom just finished brewing.

lines.zh: 就是你了，我不找别人。
lines.en: You're the one; I won't look further.

lines.zh: 找到你了，幼体。
lines.en: Found you, spawn.

lines.zh: 你，终于让我找到了。
lines.en: You—at last I've found you.

lines.zh: 别怕，很快就不疼了。
lines.en: Don't fear; the pain will pass quickly.

lines.zh: 口腔里蓄满了幽匿黏液。
lines.en: My mouth is full of sculk slime.

lines.zh: 别回头，我的毒已经到脚边。
lines.en: Don't turn—my venom is already at your feet.

lines.zh: 再近一寸就到了。
lines.en: One more inch and I'm there.

lines.zh: 这条缝是死路。
lines.en: This crevice is a dead end.

lines.zh: 腿断了，我也要护住卵。
lines.en: Even with a broken leg, I will guard the eggs.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉，我的痰比腿快。
lines.en: You can't escape; my spit is faster than your legs.

lines.zh: 喘吧，我等你喘完再吐。
lines.en: Gasp all you want; I'll spit when you're done.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我的胃越空。
lines.en: The more you run, the emptier my stomach.

lines.zh: 你沾上我的毒，就已经输了。
lines.en: Once my venom touches you, you've lost.

lines.zh: 这片幽匿脉络，我闭着眼走。
lines.en: I know these sculk veins blindfolded.

lines.zh: 从幽匿坑追你到这儿。
lines.en: I've chased you here from the sculk pit.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底擦地，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear your soles scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我不累，菌丝替我撑着。
lines.en: I don't tire; my mycelium holds me up.

lines.zh: 等等我，就等一口的距离。
lines.en: Wait for me—just one spit's distance.

lines.zh: 站住，让我把毒液咽回去。
lines.en: Stand still while I swallow my venom back.

lines.zh: 你的影子到哪，我就到哪。
lines.en: Wherever your shadow goes, I go.

lines.zh: 十五点血，只够吐一口。
lines.en: Fifteen health is enough for one spit.

lines.zh: 我矮得只到你的脚踝。
lines.en: I'm only as tall as your ankle.

lines.zh: 别躲进光里，我的毒怕晒。
lines.en: Don't hide in the light—my venom fears the sun.

lines.zh: 我闻到你留下的气味，浓得发甜。
lines.en: I smell what you left behind—thick and sweet.

lines.zh: 我不用喘气，毒囊替我呼吸。
lines.en: I needn't breathe; my venom sac breathes for me.

lines.zh: 你回头，就能看见我的毒囊。
lines.en: Turn around and you'll see my venom sac.

lines.zh: 倒下吧，别硬撑。
lines.en: Go down. Don't force it.

lines.zh: 这次抓到了，别想挣。
lines.en: Caught you this time—don't struggle.

lines.zh: 我吐出的东西，你最好别碰。
lines.en: Don't touch what I spit.

lines.zh: 我还小，吐不太准。
lines.en: I'm young — my aim isn't good yet.

lines.zh: 这一口我憋了很久。
lines.en: I've held this bite in a long time.

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞上你，听见了吗？
lines.en: My bones hit you—did you hear that?

lines.zh: 一口毒，一口疼。
lines.en: One spit of venom, one burst of pain.

lines.zh: 我擦到你了，可惜没进嘴。
lines.en: I grazed you; pity it didn't reach my mouth.

lines.zh: 别叫，太吵，毒会散。
lines.en: Don't scream—it scatters my venom.

lines.zh: 让开，别挡我的毒线。
lines.en: Move aside; don't block my line of spit.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，毒够就行。
lines.en: I'm not strong, but my venom is enough.

lines.zh: 别怪我，这一口毒憋久了。
lines.en: Don't blame me; I've held this venom too long.

lines.zh: 咔哒，咔哒，听见我的骨节吗。
lines.en: Click, click. Hear my joints?

lines.zh: 你退了一步，正好进射程。
lines.en: You stepped back—right into range.

lines.zh: 吐出去的，都是感染的种。
lines.en: What I spit carries the infection.

lines.zh: 别躲，站好，让我瞄准。
lines.en: Don't dodge; stand still and let me aim.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，带着满喉毒。
lines.en: I'm back, my throat full of venom.

lines.zh: 又是这具拼起来的身体。
lines.en: This cobbled-together body again.

lines.zh: 四周只有菌丝，我乐得清静。
lines.en: Only mycelium around me—I prefer the quiet.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我慢慢吐给你。
lines.en: The night is long; I'll spit it at you slowly.

lines.zh: 这地方，被啃干净了。
lines.en: This place has been chewed clean.

lines.zh: 菌床裂开，我撑起上身。
lines.en: The sculk bed splits, and I push myself up.

lines.zh: 醒来第一件事，就是饿。
lines.en: The first thing on waking is hunger.

lines.zh: 光太亮，我的眼刺痛。
lines.en: The light is too bright; my eyes sting.

lines.zh: 我一出生，就在找吃的。
lines.en: Since birth, I have been looking for food.

lines.zh: 谁把我从菌床里挖出来的。
lines.en: Who dug me out of the sculk bed?

lines.zh: 祭坛的菌床，我又爬回来了。
lines.en: The sculk bed at the altar—I've crawled back.

lines.zh: 幽匿的群落，我熟。
lines.en: I know this sculk colony well.

lines.zh: 站起来，我的膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I rise, and my knee cracks once.

lines.zh: 阴影里爬出来，我不出声。
lines.en: Out of shadow, I make no sound.

lines.zh: 烧起来了，我的菌壳在化。
lines.en: It's burning—my sculk shell is melting.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的壳还完整。
lines.en: I fell, and my shell held.

lines.zh: 嘴里灌了水，吐不出来。
lines.en: Water in my throat — I can't spit.

lines.zh: 炸开了，我的耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: It burst, and my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我背上，滚烫。
lines.en: The arrow in my back is hot.

lines.zh: 光顺着骨头烧进去。
lines.en: Light burns down along my bones.

lines.zh: 饿得胃里只剩回声。
lines.en: I'm so hungry my stomach only echoes.

lines.zh: 孢子被雷烤熟了。
lines.en: The spores got roasted by lightning.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的卵也没了。
lines.en: In the void, my eggs are gone too.
